title: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
official_title: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
administering_authority: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
summary: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY provides cashless health coverage of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to eligible rural and urban deprived families and senior citizens aged 70 and above across India.

benefits.description: Cashless inpatient hospitalization coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care in empanelled public and private hospitals across India.
conditions: Covers pre-existing conditions from day one
Includes 3 days pre-hospitalization and 15 days post-hospitalization costs
Pan-India portability across all empanelled hospitals

rules.explanation: Rural families meeting at least one of the 6 SECC deprivation criteria or 4 automatic inclusion categories.
Urban families belonging to one of the 11 defined occupational worker categories.
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are universally eligible under expanded PM-JAY.

required_documents.name: Aadhaar Card
required_documents.condition: Primary identity verification for individual and family members

required_documents.name: Ration Card / Family ID
required_documents.condition: Proof of family composition and SECC database linkage

application_steps.description: Visit the official NHA beneficiary portal (https://beneficiary.nha.gov.in) or visit nearest empanelled hospital / CSC.
Search beneficiary records using Mobile number, Ration card number, PM-JAY ID, or Aadhaar.
Complete e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP, IRIS, or biometric fingerprint authentication.
Upon approval by the State Health Agency (SHA), download the Ayushman Card.

source_records.publisher: National Health Authority, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India
source_records.license_or_reuse_basis: Government Open Data / Public Domain official scheme guidelines

review_notes: Verified against official NHA portal pmjay.gov.in. Logic is 'any' representing three alternative eligibility routes: rural SECC deprivation, urban occupational classification, and universal inclusion for senior citizens aged 70+. Database verification gap documented.
